title: Create: Plane and Simple
description: A modpack heavily based around Create and Create: Aeronautics. It's a very simplistic barebones pack with quite a lot of Create addons so go crazy with creativity
body:
# Create: Plane and Simple by Big Jim

## What is it!?

This pack is a Create: Aeronautics-based pack aimed at giving you the tools to make whatever you want whilst still keeping it grounded with that Minecraft feel.

My goal with this was to build a Create focussed pack for my let's play series, where you can have a great _out-of-the-box_ Aeronautics experience customized around factories and automation whilst playing with the new features and mechanics that Create: Aeronautics adds including a lot of new addon mods based around it

## Performance

I've added quite a few optimisation mods to keep this pack running smoothly. Create and Aeronautics do have a tendency to struggle with performance when you add some crazy automations or many physics based builds in one area but hopefully this should run completely smooth.

## Customization

I've added some customization so that mods like CC: Tweaked and Sophisticated Storage fit right in with Create based-textures and recipes

## Automate!

I've also added some recipes for blocks and items that usually do not have them such as all of the Create building blocks (like Asurine, Veridium etc). Both providing new automation challenges to keep you on your toes and testing your Create automation skills

## Goals?

There are no goals! Play as long or as little as you would like on the pack, no quests, just pure creative freedom and expression :)

## Credits/Shoutouts

- Massive shoutout to the JustCreateSMP and Just Create Season 2 modpack. Before creating my own pack I was originally using a heavily modified version of their pack and had a blast, this inspired me to create my own pack.
